Seeding will take place in fall or early spring to take advantage of early season moisture.
Trees and shrubs will also be planted primarily along drainage ways and north facing slopes. However more experimental work will be needed to determine the best adapted species of woody plants, and the most desirable planting methods. Preliminary indications are that herbaceous plants have a competitive advantage on the uniformly deep soil produced by the proposed reclamation methods.
In most instances the finished topography will be smoother than now exists.
1/ 
This is the currently utilized seed mixture. The seeding rates shown are for broadcast seeding. The drilling rate is 17 pounds per acre. The mixture may be changed as experience indicates or as seed for other species becomes available.
